notes: The GT dataset contains only grain Zn concentration observations (mg/kg), but the extraction data includes many other outcome variables (yield, shoot Zn, etc.). Filtering by unit='mg kg-1' or similar is needed, but the GT already appears pre-filtered to grain Zn only.

The GT effect column 'zn_effect_rr' appears to be log response ratio (ln(treatment/control)), matching the extraction field 'ln_rr'. The extraction 'effect_pct' field is percent change and should NOT be used for GT comparison.
The extraction data contains observations for non-wheat crops (rice, maize) from some papers - these should be excluded when matching to GT which is wheat-only.
Study IDs in GT range 1-86 with 90 unique values, suggesting some studies have sub-IDs or decimal values. The paper_ids in extraction use numeric prefixes that should map to GT study_id.
The 'Dong_2018', 'Li_2013', 'Liu_2014', 'Rashid_2019', 'Zhang_2017' papers lack numeric prefixes in extraction - their GT study_id mappings are estimated and may need verification.
The GT 'n' column represents replication (sample size) and is shared for both control and treatment (same n for both arms), with values 2-16.
Some extraction observations have tissue types other than grain (shoot, ear leaf) - these should be filtered to tissue='grain' when comparing to GT.
The extraction moderators.application_method field uses lowercase values ('soil', 'foliar', 'leaf', 'seed') while GT app_type uses title case ('Soil', 'Foliar', 'Soil+Foliar') - normalization needed.
The 'seed' and 'seed priming' application methods in extraction do not have a direct GT equivalent and may be excluded from the GT dataset.
Unit mismatches are present in extraction data (mg/kg, mg kg-1, mg kg-1 DW, etc.) - all should map to the GT's mg/kg grain Zn concentration.
The extraction paper '14_37_Liu_2019' has a compound ID suggesting it may cover two GT studies (14 and 37).
Control means in GT range 5-64.43 mg/kg and treatment means 8-83.84 mg/kg, consistent with grain Zn concentrations. Extraction values outside this range for grain Zn likely represent other outcomes.

id_parsing.note: Compound study IDs like 14/37 use / separator. Match on first part (paper ID).
